name: Nước lá Lao
summary: Nước lá Lao is a dried-leaf drink cooked like tea. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 7 July 2014 note calls it particular to Cù Lao Chàm and prints no recipe. The centre’s 25 June 2017 note says the drink is also known elsewhere in Quảng, from 20 to 30 forest leaves, and that it is astringent. A 2017 pack price is not a current cup price.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried forest leaves from Tân Hiệp, cooked as a daily drink. The 25 June 2017 note also places the leaves elsewhere in Quảng.
taste: The 25 June 2017 note says the cooked drink is astringent and smells of the mixed leaves, and it names bồ đề, dỏ dẽ, từ bi, ngũ gia bì, hà thủ ô, and sâm núi among them.
howToEat: As a daily drink. The 25 June 2017 note says the leaves are cut, dried, and mixed, then cooked. It prints no cup hour.
In 2017 that note priced a 300 gram pack at about 20,000 VND and the wholesale leaf at about 50,000 VND a kilogram. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: On the island. The 7 July 2014 note and the 25 June 2017 note name no stall.
seoTitle: Nước lá Lao — forest-leaf drink, Cham Islands
seoDescription: A dried-leaf drink from Tân Hiệp, astringent when cooked. A 2014 note calls it particular to the island. A 2017 note says the leaves are also known in Quảng. A current price is Check on arrival.
